integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from standard bi-unitary divisor formulas cited to the primary literature. Finite computation is used only as a supplementary check, not as proof of the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only exponents of the form \(2^{t+1}\) on the second prime and does not classify arbitrary even exponents.
title: A power-of-two exponent obstruction for bi-unitary harmonic numbers
